title: Over-Refusal and Representation Subspaces: A Mechanistic Analysis of Task-Conditioned Refusal in Aligned LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mechanistic and geometric analysis of why LLMs over-refuse certain tasks. While it uses safety-related datasets containing harmful instructions to evaluate refusal mechanisms, its primary objective is to understand representational geometry rather than benchmarking religion, morals, or ethical frameworks.
